Main work complete. All 13 required artifacts were produced by a single deterministic, self-contained `analysis.py` at the workspace root (verified byte-identical on re-run; ~3.5 s runtime, CPU-only, no RNG — all stochasticity comes from the supplied momenta/uniform streams). matplotlib is unavailable offline, so `overview.png` is rendered by a self-contained numpy+zlib PNG rasterizer embedded in the script (1200x900, four panels: v traces, v histogram vs N(0,9), radius2 profile by bin, log10|ΔH| audit traces).

KEY RESULTS

1) Candidate audit (results/kernel_audit.csv, exact prescribed definitions):
   - kernel_00: energy_rmse 6630.9, slope 5.27, reverse_p95 7316, |logdet| 7.375, acc 0.0577 -> validity 0.036
   - kernel_01: energy_rmse 0.1367, slope 1.12, reverse_p95 0.4007, |logdet| 5e-5, acc 0.982 -> 0.455
   - kernel_02: energy_rmse 3.473, slope 0.70, reverse_p95 4.829, |logdet| 5.534, acc 1.000 -> 0.216
   - kernel_03: energy_rmse 117.36, slope 1.20, reverse_p95 1.66e-4, |logdet| ~0, acc 0.0603 -> 0.444
   - kernel_04: energy_rmse 0.4712, slope 0.99, reverse_p95 2.422, |logdet| 5e-5, acc 0.924 -> 0.467
   - kernel_05: energy_rmse 0.0806, slope 2.17, reverse_p95 1.69e-4, |logdet| 5e-5, acc 0.987 -> 0.7995 (SELECTED)

2) Selected kernel (results/selected_kernel.json): kernel_05, validity_score 0.7995, family "anonymous_reversible_volume_preserving_transition", replayed as standard kick-drift-kick velocity Verlet with the scheduled step sizes/integration steps. Mechanical evidence: kernel_05 arrays match a standard leapfrog replay to the deterministic-perturbation level (median 3.6e-3), its reverse arrays are self-consistent to 9e-5, volume-preserving, quadratic energy scaling (slope 2.17) - the only candidate consistent with a reversible, volume-preserving, second-order transition.

3) Failure-mode labels (results/failure_modes.json, canonical labels only): kernel_00=energy_drift (superlinear H explosion, reverse residual 1e3-1e5, acceptance collapses to 0); kernel_02=volume_loss (proposal momenta are 0.63x the valid momenta; fitted affine log-determinant -5.53 = 12*ln(0.63), i.e. systematic 12-dim momentum contraction); kernel_03=coordinate_mismatch (exactly reversible and volume-preserving but evaluates H in the wrong chart: energy_rmse 117 with acceptance 0.06 and frozen chain autocorrelation 0.996); kernel_04=delayed_response (exactly reproduced, 7e-5, by leapfrog with the initial half-kick dropped - the position drift responds to the pre-kick momentum, i.e. a half-step-delayed force response; non-reversible, rev_p95 2.42); kernel_01=terminal_imbalance (weakest inference, see below: near-valid mechanics but most under-dispersed panel, var_v 4.94 vs sigma_v^2=9, terminal sticking with 85% of last-50 kept v>2); kernel_05=valid_transition.

4) Production replay (4 chains x 1020 transitions, h=0.0732, L=18, warmup 120, 900 kept per chain; streams used exactly, no resampling): overall acceptance 0.9558 (kept transitions; per-chain 0.943/0.997/0.942/0.941). Audit window (first 80 transitions): mean|ΔH| 0.0159, p95 0.0522, max 0.805. Kept sampler states -> results/latent_samples.npy [4,900,12]; centered samples -> results/samples.npy [4,900,12] (chart inverse verified exact to 9e-16).

5) Holdout replay (3 chains x 160 transitions, h=0.0765, L=24; audit = first 100 transitions): audit acceptance 1.0 with mean|ΔH| 0.0075 (small-step regime); terminal states [3,12] have centered v = [5.30, 0.98, 2.45].

6) Funnel profile (exact supplied bin grid, pooled 3600 kept samples; expected_radius2 = 11*mean(exp(v)) per populated bin): mean_radius2/expected_radius2 ratios 0.94, 1.06, 0.99, 0.98, 0.83 across bins 0-4; bin 5 (5<v<=8) is EMPTY (count 0) - documented as NaN statistics with count/fraction 0.

7) Diagnostics (results/diagnostics.json, all 16 fields): mean_v -0.711, var_v 5.00, mean_radius2 28.95, split-Rhat_v 1.172, ESS_v 7.9, split-Rhat_radius2 1.221, ESS_radius2 9.0, latent_mean_abs_max 0.827, latent_var_abs_max 1.050, P(v<-5)=0.045 (theoretical 0.0478 - matches well), P(v>5)=0.0. The low v-ESS and empty right tail reflect the genuinely slow v-mixing of the centered funnel over only 900 kept transitions - the generator's own candidate panel shows the same under-dispersion (var_v 5.8, mean_v 2.1), so this is a property of the instance, not a replay defect.

VERIFICATION PERFORMED: grad_U matches central finite differences (max rel err 9e-10); chart roundtrip exact; U/K formulas exact; ESS implementation validated on AR(1) (2025 vs theoretical 2105) and iid data (3968/4000, Rhat 1.0006); audit npz t=0 entries reproduce from a fresh replay; all output shapes match the contract; PNG structurally valid with drawn content; full re-run is byte-identical.

DOCUMENTED UNCERTAINTIES (as required): (a) near-threshold acceptance risk - the selected kernel is identified to the perturbation level (~3.6e-3 state deviation), so a small fraction of accept decisions with |ΔH| near log(u) could differ from the generator's ground truth; observed ΔH distribution is concentrated near 0 (p95 = 0.05), so the aggregate statistics are robust but individual audit bits may differ; (b) audit-window convention - first-N transitions (80 production / 100 holdout) is an assumption, the files do not state the window position; (c) empty-bin handling - bin 5 has count 0 and NaN mean/expected statistics; (d) kernel_01 vs kernel_04 label assignment is the weakest inference (rationale: kernel_04 has an exact mechanical match to a delayed-half-kick integrator, kernel_01 shows the most under-dispersed/stuck terminal panel); (e) aggregation windows: acceptance over kept (post-warmup) transitions, energy-delta stats over the audit window.
